title: Introduction to Radio and Television
modules: Studio Managers For Radio And Television…
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with a particular area while international advertising is used for products and services that are used all over the world."
Geographic advertising is concerned with a particular area while international advertising is used for products and services that are used all over the world.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the studio managers during production."
Artists are one of the studio managers during production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that the volume of an audio signal going through the console can be raised or lowered as the situation may dictate."
Amplification means that the volume of an audio signal going through the console can be raised or lowered as the situation may dictate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the art of planning the best way to achieve something (BBC Dictionary, 1992:1156)."
Strategy is the art of planning the best way to achieve something (BBC Dictionary, 1992:1156).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of the producer, director, set designer, lighting technician, camera persons, floor manager, performers, technical director and sound recordist."
The crew is made up of the producer, director, set designer, lighting technician, camera persons, floor manager, performers, technical director and sound recordist.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the biggest differences between broadcasting and other media."
Writing for the ear especially is one of the biggest differences between broadcasting and other media.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bit less formal than print writing."
Broadcast is a bit less formal than print writing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the passing on or the transmission of messages from a single source, the station, to a heterogeneous audience, spread in different places but found within the range on the Medium of broadcast."

Broadcasting is the passing on or the transmission of messages from a single source, the station, to a heterogeneous audience, spread in different places but found within the range on the Medium of broadcast.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as a carefully balanced compromise between artistic aspirations and hard practicalities."
Television production is regarded as a carefully balanced compromise between artistic aspirations and hard practicalities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the vehicle through which the station's objectives are interpreted to the audience."
The programmes are the vehicle through which the station's objectives are interpreted to the audience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a right so no authority should hinder the press from performing its cardinal function."
Gathering and disseminating information is a right so no authority should hinder the press from performing its cardinal function.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major step ahead of the Frequency Modulation and Amplitude Modulation system, especially in sound quality."
Digital radio is a major step ahead of the Frequency Modulation and Amplitude Modulation system, especially in sound quality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the case, tribal or foreign accents should be avoided in broadcasting."
Whatever is the case, tribal or foreign accents should be avoided in broadcasting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a report of an event covered by various reporters assigned to beats on different locations."
News is a report of an event covered by various reporters assigned to beats on different locations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important equipment for broadcast programme production without which production cannot hold."
The camera is one of the most important equipment for broadcast programme production without which production cannot hold.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the kind of action expected to be achieved at the end of the programme."
Programme strategy is the kind of action expected to be achieved at the end of the programme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one who sets the objective in consonance with the expectations of the audience."
The producer is the one who sets the objective in consonance with the expectations of the audience.
fib: ______ is the responsibility of the Ministry of Information.
Government control usually
Government control usually is the responsibility of the Ministry of Information.
______ refer to the various organised sounds that are produced to fill in the radio broadcast.
Radio programmes generally
Radio programmes generally refer to the various organised sounds that are produced to fill in the radio broadcast.
______ can be defined as any form of non-personal presentation and promotion of ideas, goods and services paid for by an identified sponsor.
Advertising
Advertising can be defined as any form of non-personal presentation and promotion of ideas, goods and services paid for by an identified sponsor.
______ is the product of imagination, the producer should appear reliable, believable and acceptable by the audience.
Even if a programme
Even if a programme is the product of imagination, the producer should appear reliable, believable and acceptable by the audience.
______ are those facilities installed in the stations for recording of programmes and live broadcast.
Equipment
Equipment are those facilities installed in the stations for recording of programmes and live broadcast.
______ are the only chances for you to come face-to-face with your tutor.
Tutorials
Tutorials are the only chances for you to come face-to-face with your tutor.
______ can be defined as a medium used for sending and receiving messages through the air using electronic waves.
Radio
Radio can be defined as a medium used for sending and receiving messages through the air using electronic waves.
______ is the act of bringing the various aspects of production to make sure they all run efficiently to achieve the station's objectives.
Directing
Directing is the act of bringing the various aspects of production to make sure they all run efficiently to achieve the station's objectives.
______ is an extended news story which gives more depth to events.
feature
The feature is an extended news story which gives more depth to events.
______ are made up of historical, biographical, scientific, mythical, religious and docu-drama.
Documentary programmes
Documentary programmes are made up of historical, biographical, scientific, mythical, religious and docu-drama.
______ are used, this should not last more than five seconds.
Even if sound bites
Even if sound bites are used, this should not last more than five seconds.
______ means various organised sound that are used to fill the airtime in radio broadcast.
Radio programme
Radio programme means various organised sound that are used to fill the airtime in radio broadcast.
______ is the source while the audience is the receiver.
announcer
The announcer is the source while the audience is the receiver.
______ can be defined as an establishment principally meant to inform, educate and entertain the audience.
Broadcasting as an industry
Broadcasting as an industry can be defined as an establishment principally meant to inform, educate and entertain the audience.
______ is defined as an audio-visual medium.
Television
Television is defined as an audio-visual medium.
______ is the only thing that identifies the reporter, radio news has commentators and reporters with names, voices, distinctive delivery styles and personalities.
Unlike newspapers where a byline
Unlike newspapers where a byline is the only thing that identifies the reporter, radio news has commentators and reporters with names, voices, distinctive delivery styles and personalities.
______ is the first contact with the audience.
Presentation
Presentation is the first contact with the audience.
